city.match: Match each religious building to its city.

rows.label: Basilica and Expiatory Church of the Holy Family
rows.description: basilica under construction since 1882 in Barcelona, Spain
rows.hook: is a long-unfinished landmark designed by a famous architect known for nature-inspired forms

rows.label: Jagannath Temple
rows.hook: hosts a yearly festival where enormous wooden chariots are pulled through the streets by crowds

rows.label: St. Basil's Cathedral
rows.hook: is crowned with swirling, brightly painted onion domes beside a famous red-bricked square

rows.label: Meenakshi Temple
rows.description: historic Hindu temple in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India
rows.hook: is dedicated to a goddess and crowded with towering gateways covered in colorful sculpted figures

rows.label: Prophet's Mosque
rows.hook: was founded by the founder of Islam and shelters his tomb beneath a famous green dome

rows.label: Prahadisvarar Temple
rows.description: 11th century Tamil Chola Dynasty Temple and UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is a granite Chola-built shrine to Shiva crowned by a massive carved capstone

rows.label: Archbasilica of St. John Lateran
rows.hook: is the pope's official cathedral as a bishop, ranking above the Vatican's more famous basilica

rows.label: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore
rows.description: largest Catholic Marian church in Rome
rows.hook: is the biggest Catholic church dedicated to the Virgin Mary

rows.label: Fushimi Inari-taisha
rows.hook: is famous for thousands of bright orange gates winding up a forested mountain

rows.label: Temple of Heaven
rows.description: imperial complex of religious buildings in Beijing, China
rows.hook: is where emperors performed rituals for good harvests, centred on a round blue-roofed hall

rows.label: Umayyad Mosque
rows.hook: is one of the oldest and largest places of Islamic worship, said to shelter the head of John the Baptist

rows.label: Pashupatinath Temple
rows.hook: is a major Hindu pilgrimage site to Shiva on the banks of the Bagmati River

rows.label: Somnath temple
rows.hook: is a Shiva shrine on the Arabian Sea coast, revered as the first of twelve sacred jyotirlinga sites
